title: Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit Unit Service Credit
content:
# Unit Service Credit

A cancelled Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plan of the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans earns a unit service credit for customer-pay labor work done at the group on the plan's unit. The credit counts labor lines charged with pay type customer pay on repair orders for that unit, as recorded in the Service Accounts and Repair Orders records. Deductible lines owed on covered work are not counted.

| Customer-pay labor lines on the plan's unit | Unit service credit (USD) |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 30.00 |
| 1 or 2 | 15.00 |
| None | None |

**Reading the count.**
- Only labor lines count. Parts, diagnostic fees and shop fees on the same repair order are not labor lines.
- Only lines for the plan's own unit count. Labor on the customer's other vehicles does not.
- The count is not limited to a period.

Hypothetical check: a unit with two customer-pay labor lines and one service contract deductible line has 2 counted lines, which earns 15.00.
